caption: The drawing depicts a rectangular wooden chest with a hinged lid partially open. The exterior of the chest is painted in a blue color, with some areas where the paint has worn off, showing the natural wood underneath. The interior and the underside of the lid are a natural wood color with visible grain patterns. Two dark-colored metal hinges attach the lid to the chest, and a metal handle is present on the side facing the viewer. Inside the chest, there is a compartment divider, forming a smaller section on the right-hand side. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color.
title: Utility Chest
